businessScenario: 财务管理系统总分核对-将存款明细账（分户账）与总账科目余额进行比对，检测账务差异

fdmScriptsAnalyzed.transformLogic: 从核心总账系统TDM表（T_FIGL_ZFAGLFLEXT_1）全量入FDM，通过F_CO_TRANS_CD转换币种代码
从TDM层科目表（T_FIGL_ZSAPKMCS）拉链入FDM，字段直接映射（ZKMUHAO→subj_no, ZKEMUMC→subj_name等），支持新增修改删除变更

knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_FIN_TB_CHECK (check_no, check_desc, check_sub_no, check_sub_name, dtl_acct_bal, gl_bal, margin_val, check_dt)
SELECT '40001' AS check_no, '总分核对-存款' AS check_desc,
  A.subj_no AS check_sub_no, NVL(C.subj_name,'其它') AS check_sub_name,
  NVL(A.acct_bal,0) AS dtl_acct_bal, NVL(B.acct_bal,0) AS gl_bal,
  NVL(A.acct_bal,0) - NVL(B.acct_bal,0) AS margin_val, DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AS check_dt
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN subj_no='220406' then '22040699' WHEN subj_no='220202' then '22020299' ELSE subj_no END AS SUBJ_NO,
    SUM(acct_bal + CASE WHEN acct_no='20170609114410000012' THEN 0 ELSE ldr_frozen_principal END) AS acct_bal
  FROM CDM.C_AGT_DEPOSIT_ACCT_INF
  WHERE data_dt=DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND subj_no NOT IN ('2217','615199','270501','2006')
  GROUP BY 1
) A
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT T1.subj_no, SUM(term_end_bal_credit)-SUM(term_end_bal_debit) AS acct_bal
  FROM FDM.F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_BAL_TAB T1
  WHERE period_dt='{ETL_TX_DT}' AND currcy_cd <> '@RMB' AND org_no = '0099'
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(term_end_bal_credit)>0
) B ON A.subj_no = B.subj_no
LEFT JOIN FDM.F_FI_FIGL_SUBJ_LVL_RELA C
  ON A.subj_no = C.subj_no AND C.start_dt<=DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND C.end_dt>DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND C.del_flag <> 'D'
knowledgeBlocks.tracedSqlCode:
INSERT INTO CDM.C_FIN_TB_CHECK(...)
SELECT '40001', '总分核对-存款', A.subj_no, NVL(C.subj_name,'其它'),
  NVL(A.acct_bal,0), NVL(B.acct_bal,0), NVL(A.acct_bal,0)-NVL(B.acct_bal,0), DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}'
FROM (
  SELECT 存款科目调整(subj_no='220406'→'22040699', '220202'→'22020299'), SUM(账户余额+冻结本金) AS acct_bal
  FROM C_AGT_DEPOSIT_ACCT_INF
  WHERE data_dt=当日 AND 排除特殊科目('2217','615199','270501','2006')
  GROUP BY 调整后科目
) A
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT subj_no, SUM(期末贷方余额-期末借方余额) FROM ODM.O_FIGL_ZFAGLFLEXT_1
  WHERE period_dt=当日 AND 非本币 AND org_no='0099'
  GROUP BY subj_no HAVING SUM(term_end_bal_credit)>0
) B ON A.subj_no=B.subj_no
LEFT JOIN FDM科目层级关系表 C ON A.subj_no=C.subj_no AND 拉链有效 AND 未删除

derivedKnowledge.knowledgeName: 总账存款科目余额查询
derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT subj_no, SUM(term_end_bal_credit) - SUM(term_end_bal_debit) AS acct_bal FROM O_FIGL_ZFAGLFLEXT_1 WHERE period_name='{日期}' AND currency_code NOT IN (SELECT stand_cd_val FROM F_CO_TRANS_CD WHERE stand_cd_tab_no='FIGL0004' AND src_cd_val='RMB') AND segment1='0099' GROUP BY subj_no HAVING SUM(term_end_bal_credit)>0

derivedKnowledge.derivedSql: SELECT A.subj_no, A.acct_bal AS dtl_bal, B.acct_bal AS gl_bal, A.acct_bal - B.acct_bal AS margin FROM detail_account A LEFT JOIN general_ledger B ON A.subj_no = B.subj_no WHERE A.acct_bal <> B.acct_bal OR B.acct_bal IS NULL
derivedKnowledge.businessMeaning: 对比存款分户账与总账的科目余额差异，定位账务不一致的科目

keyBusinessRules.description: 存款科目220406和220202需映射到99级科目进行对账
特定账户不参与冻结本金计算
总账科目余额仅取机构0099的数据
总账中仅保留贷方余额大于0的科目参与核对
